name: softicon-flipbook
description: PDF and image flipbook block for the WordPress block editor

scripts.zip:
rm -f softicon-flipbook.zip && printf '→ Building block
' && (npm run -s build >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run build) && printf '→ Translations
' && (npm run -s i18n-pot >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run i18n-pot) && npm run -s find-ds && printf '→ Zipping
' && cd .. && zip -rq softicon-flipbook/softicon-flipbook.zip softicon-flipbook/softicon-flipbook.php softicon-flipbook/index.php softicon-flipbook/includes softicon-flipbook/assets softicon-flipbook/vendor softicon-flipbook/src softicon-flipbook/build softicon-flipbook/languages softicon-flipbook/readme.txt softicon-flipbook/package.json softicon-flipbook/webpack.config.js -x '*/.DS_Store' '*.map'
scripts.postzip:
printf '
✔ Zip ready: %s
  %s files, %s

' "$PWD/softicon-flipbook.zip" "$(unzip -l softicon-flipbook.zip | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')" "$(du -h softicon-flipbook.zip | cut -f1 | tr -d ' ')"
scripts.bundle: npm run lint && npm run zip
